reasoning: The icon clearly depicts a speech bubble with an outgoing right arrow, universally representing sending, replying to, or forwarding a chat/text message. Messaging and replying to people are among the most common everyday to-do items across personal and work lists. At tiny sizes the small bottom-left tail might be missed, making it slightly resemble a generic box-with-arrow export or sign-out icon.
